page.layout: One column of running text on a single printed page, with Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac and Greek words inline. No margin notes. A catchword-like Hebrew word sits alone at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: Lucæ 10.30. [Syriac] Modicum ex multo, h.e. Ex parte, [Greek] 2.ad Cor.1.14.& 1.epist.13.9. 12.ad Rom.15.24.Plur. [Hebrew] Fœmin.[Hebrew], Jer.2.23. [Hebrew] Ch. Parum,paucum,paucitas,Gen.43.1.in Jon. [Hebrew] Chal. Velocitas, celeritas, levitas: [Hebrew] Cum velocitate,velociter,celeriter.
[Hebrew] Ch.Hydria, Urceus, Gen.24.14.15.16.17.Convenit cum [Hebrew]. Sic Syr. [Syriac] Et reliquit hydriam suam,Joh.4.28.
[Hebrew] Chald. Idem: vel olla,pelvis, vasis genus,Numer. 19.9. in Jonath.
[Hebrew] Chald. Spurcities, stercus,fimus, Levit.17.16.in Jon.Stultitia,stoliditas,Num.25.in Jon.
[Hebrew] Chal. Stercus,sterquilinium,fimus. Scribitur & elisa una littera, [Hebrew], Esth. 6.11. in Targ. sec. quod & in aliis factum,ut Golgotha, pro Golgoltha.Plur. [Hebrew] & [Hebrew] Thren.4.5.
[Hebrew] Ch. Pediculus: Pediculorum multitudo,quasi Pediculium,Resp.Hebr. [Hebrew]. Plur.[Hebrew], [Hebrew] & masc. [Hebrew].
[Hebrew] Chald. Redimicula, Alligamenta, quibus ligabant capillos, juxta R.Salom. Respondet Hebr. [Hebrew]. Kimchius scribit [Hebrew]. In Aruch [Hebrew], Jesa.3.20.

page.notes: Many Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac and Greek words are printed inline and are only approximated above; the Hebrew and Syriac strings are not reliably transcribed letter by letter. The Syriac line after "Lucæ 10.30." and the Greek "Κάλαμος" are uncertain. The small mark at the left margin beside "Jon.Stultitia" is a printer's manicule, not text. A faint show-through of the facing page is present and omitted.
